provenance.source_reference: generated by tools/crude-grades/grades.mjs (batch 2026-11-04-open-thermo-data; E10, E11, E14)
advisory_evidence: GENERATED_GRADE: no assay values; Riazi 1989 TBP distribution on the shared crude_pc01..12 cuts, shape first (E10): TBP, C1-C5 and 565 C+ meet the specification
API_FROM_CUTS: density and API are what the shared cuts give; the cuts carry the Watson K (11.6-12.0) of the Tia Juana Light characterisation
LIGHT_END_SPLIT: the C1-C5 split by mass is an assumption (CRUDE_GRADES_REVIEW 3.1)
SULFUR_METADATA: sulfur is a specification for display only; no sulfur species are carried
TRANSPORT: cut liquid viscosity Twu 1985 + ASTM D341 (twu-1985-d341-r1); liquid-mixture pair coefficient fitted to ECCC whole crudes (OGL-Canada)
DILBIT_BLEND: 76 % generated raw bitumen (T0 473 K, B 1.5, 50 % 565 C+) + 24 % generated condensate (API 70, 25 % C1-C5), by mass (E11)
DILBIT_LIMIT: on these cuts the dilbit reads API 29.0 against about 21.5 for real dilbit, and its liquid viscosity is about 20 times too low (E11)

specification.open_references: ECCC Cold Lake Blend Winter [2015] (2712, API 22.0), Western Canadian Select (2709.1, API 21.1)
